model_description: Learned Horner ensemble with width-9 and width-16 TCN specialists for Tiers 2-3 plus a 99,824-parameter width-independent cellular specialist through Tier 4. Each scans a sanctioned pairwise-reduced operand through a trained recurrent state and emits one base-p digit. Inputs above the learned boundary receive a deterministic zero fallback.
training_description: The Tier-2/3 specialists were trained for 2,400 AdamW steps using learned width transfer and quotient-2/boundary mining. The cellular specialist used an 8/12/16/20/24-bit mixed-width curriculum followed by direct width-32 official-distribution continuation. Frozen five-seed gates scored 499/500 on Tier 3 and 483/500 on Tier 4. Checked Tier-3/4 answers were not used for training or selection. Seed 20260712.
